preconditions.description: Number of cities and citizens within specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= v <= n and 1 <= u <= n and v != u for v, u in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road connects two distinct cities within the valid range.
Exactly n-1 roads form a connected graph.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= xi <= n and 1 <= yi <= n and xi != yi for xi, yi in citizens)
preconditions.description: Each citizen lives and works in distinct cities within the valid range.

postconditions.description: Total number of puppies needed is within the valid range.

postconditions.expression: 0 <= q <= min(m, k) and 0 <= e <= min(n - 1, k) and q + e == k
postconditions.description: Number of puppies given to citizens and guardians sums up to the total number of puppies needed.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= m for ai in citizen_puppies)
postconditions.description: Each citizen index given a puppy is within the valid range.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= bi <= n - 1 for bi in guardian_puppies)
postconditions.description: Each guardian index given a puppy is within the valid range.

postconditions.expression: all(citizen_happy(i) for i in range(1, m + 1))
postconditions.description: All citizens are happy after distributing the puppies.
